title: Netheroreoverlay
description: This is oreoverlay but in the nether, works exactly the same
body:
Experimenting mod

NetherOreOverlay is a client-side Fabric mod for Minecraft 1.21.11 that helps you find ores by predicting nearby ore locations from a world seed and drawing them as colored in-world overlays. This only works in the nether.

Huge thanks to the creator (armi1014) of OreOverLay, without them this mod wouldn't exist. 

https://modrinth.com/mod/oreoverlay
Go check them out.



Notes
- This mod is client-side only
- Designed for Minecraft 1.21.11
- Intended for singleplayer, testing, seed analysis, and technical experimentation
- Does not include server-side code or interact with Minecraft servers
- Always respect the rules of any server or community where you play
